about: Snape's office, the model's snape-office, off the dungeon corridor (Magic's req 929, docs/magic/rooms.md, *Snape's office*; Godric's 1 on magic-snape-office-way-in-1022, 22 October 2026, 1.34 pm; Interiors' schedule docs/interiors/potions-dungeon.md). Every year. The room is always the same (the cold, the jars, a few more each castle year, the fire by season, the stores' cupboard locked, his desk and chair, the door shut behind him); the way in is an errand: now and then, at the bell that ends a lesson in the Potions dungeon, Snape hands him the class's flagons in a rack, "On my desk. Touch nothing.", the office door is unlocked for that errand only, and the door shuts and is plain again once he leaves. The var errand runs none, on (the rack in his hands, the door unlocked), done (the rack set down), and is cleared at leave. The dungeon corridor's plain-door line in potions.json takes errand != on and errand != done. Snape is cold but fair, terse, never mocking, never unfair (the world rules, Classes); nothing on the shelves moves for him and nothing is taken.
